decisions.choice: Fixed yellow miniature on a dark stand, no stickers; prioritize recognizable silhouette and real native parts over exact scale
decisions.reason: Bound the first end-to-end design rehearsal; no size or playable mechanism was requested

decisions.choice: Move bell outside the coil with visible clearance; leave neck/bracket unresolved
decisions.reason: User identified bell/coil interference. Native surfaces confirmed intersections; spatial separation fixes that defect without claiming a physical attachment.

decisions.choice: Clear the fourteen remaining R2 surface crossings: translate the full valve assembly 24 LDU toward the front, raise the entire mouthpipe 26 LDU, and replace six vertical slide 3L axles with 2L axles centered at the elbow mouths.
decisions.reason: User requested repair. Keep all 92 physical parts and internal valve/pipe seats. The shortened axles stop inside the wider brick underside cavity instead of piercing its small hollow stud. This fixes interference but does not establish axle clutch in the cavity, slide retention, or the existing unresolved mounts.
